segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ כׇּל הַנֶּאֱכָל בְּשׁוֹר הַגָּדוֹל — יֵאָכֵל בִּגְדִי הָרַךְ, וְרָאשֵׁי כְנָפַיִם וְהַסְּחוּסִים.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «Anything that is» fit to be «eaten in an adult ox,» whose bones have fully hardened, may «be eaten in a young kid.» One may register for a Paschal offering in order to eat any of these parts, and eating any such part is considered a fulfillment of the mitzva to eat the Paschal lamb. However, any part of the animal that is inedible in an adult ox is not considered meat, even if it is soft enough to be eaten in a young kid. One may not register for a Paschal offering in order to eat one of these parts, and eating it is not a fulfillment of the mitzva to eat the Paschal lamb. «And» the soft «ends of the ribs and the cartilage» are soft enough to be considered edible and may therefore be eaten from the Paschal lamb.

moves.summary: Edibility standard for the Paschal lamb

positions.claim: edibility is measured by an adult ox; rib tips and cartilage may be eaten
